samples.summary: The new todo doc leaves every checkbox unchecked even though the described work is already implemented in the repository (font-catalog.ts already has ensurePreviewFontLink with the exact `data-wafflebase-font-preview` marker and weight-fallback logic, and the three test files it lists — ensure-font-link.test.ts, font-family-picker.test.ts, more-fonts-dialog.test.ts — already contain the preview-specific assertions described). Other lessons+todo pairs in this repo (e.g. 20260819-font-list-preview-todo.md, 20260811-cli-upstream-error-envelope-todo.md) mark completed work `[x]` and leave only genuinely outstanding verification items unchecked. Presenting a fully-implemented feature as an all-unchecked, actively-open TODO misleads a future reader/agent into thinking the work is still to be done.
samples.evidence: Every item under `## Approach` and `## Tests` is `- [ ]` (unchecked), e.g. '- [ ] `ensurePreviewFontLink` marks its link with a **different** attribute...' but `packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/font-catalog.ts` already implements exactly this (comments at lines 167-172, 236-246), and `packages/frontend/tests/components/text-formatting/ensure-font-link.test.ts` already contains matching test cases (e.g. 'requests only the row text, under the preview marker', 'a previewed family still loads in full when selected').
